task: Write RESOURCES_EXPLOITATION.md: everything that helps EXPLOIT specific real players rather than play unexploitably. Cover at least: HUD and tracking software that already computes per-opponent statistics from hand histories (PokerTracker 4, Hold'em Manager 3, Hand2Note, DriveHUD -- prices, whether stats can be read out programmatically or from their databases), open-source opponent-modelling code (implementations of DBBR, Bayesian opponent models, implicit modelling, RLCard/OpenSpiel exploitative agents, academic code released with papers on exploiting humans multiway), large HUMAN hand-history datasets with player identities that could seed population baselines and archetypes (IRC poker database, public PokerStars/other hand-history corpora, Kaggle sets, the datasets behind published player-type studies -- licence and size), and published player-type classification schemes with real numbers. For each: what it gives us toward per-opponent exploitation at 2-9 players, and how it would connect to a bot deciding in real time. Research, not code. Verify EVERY resource is real by actually visiting it (repo page, docs, pricing page): record URL, what it is, last activity date, licence, price if paid, whether it runs on macOS/Python, and whether it is a real working thing or an abandoned demo. For each, rate against the operator's requirements: (a) 2-9 players, (b) true no-limit sizing, (c) exploiting specific opponents by identity, (d) reachable in HOURS on one laptop -- no multi-day computing, (e) the project is private and never distributed, so paid tools and GPL code are both acceptable. End with a ranked shortlist and a one-paragraph recommendation of what to adopt first. A separate worker is already surveying poker ENGINES (OpenSpiel, RLCard, PyPokerEngine, PokerKit, clubs, PokerRL) for ENGINE_ALTERNATIVES.md; do not duplicate that, cite it as 'see ENGINE_ALTERNATIVES.md' and go wider. Do not touch OPPONENT_MODEL_DESIGN.md, CLAUDE.md, or any existing file; write only your one new file. Run fleet tooling from /Users/chasethompson/heater (bin/inbox.py check, bin/queue.py add). pokerbot has no GitHub remote: commit on your branch, nothing to push.
done_when: RESOURCES_EXPLOITATION.md committed on the branch with at least 8 verified resources including at least 2 real hand-history datasets, each rated on the five criteria, ending with a ranked shortlist and one recommendation
